lines.en: My steps land heavier than before.

lines.zh: 浮岛的边缘在我脚下碎。
lines.en: The island edge crumbles under me.
Violet sparks trail behind me.
These islands are mine.
Each step darkens the sky a little.
The air here tastes of iron.

lines.zh: 我踩过的地方留下一道暗线。
lines.en: A dark line stays where I have trodden.
Rubble turns around my feet.
I walk on and the iron smell thickens.
I walk between these islands.

lines.zh: 我站着，看着那些黑柱子。
lines.en: I stand and look at the black pillars.
Those pillars stand shorter than I do.
There used to be others here.
Now not one is left.

lines.zh: 掌心的紫火自己转起来。
lines.en: Purple fire turns by itself in my palm.
Violet fire burns in my palm.
I close my hand and it goes out.
Hurrying serves no purpose.
You will see it soon enough.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸让岛上的灰浮起来。
lines.en: My breath lifts the ash off the island.
The ash settles on the pillars.
Those pillars are mine.
I forget when.
End stone cracks under my step.
That one is violet too.

lines.zh: 那根柱子，是我亲手立的。
lines.en: I raised that pillar with my own hands.
You stand straighter than I expected.
You're the first to look up at me.

lines.zh: 你的护甲在紫光下发白。
lines.en: Your armor looks white in the violet.
That colour will deceive you.
Until you see it turn black.

lines.zh: 你的脸在紫光里看不清。
lines.en: Your face is hard to read in the violet.
That does not matter.
I need not read your face.
I only listen to your breathing.
Your breathing is sinking.
You lowered your head.
Now that is proper.
There is no need to look up here.

lines.zh: 你手里的武器没举起来。
lines.en: Your weapon is not raised.
Then put it down.
I did not move my heel.

lines.zh: 紫色的血落在石头上，冒了一下烟。
lines.en: Violet blood drips onto stone and smokes.
This body is harder than before.
Can you even hurt me.
You have spent a lot of strength.

lines.zh: 伤口自己合上，只留焦痕。
lines.en: The wound closes, leaving only a scorch.
There is almost no blood.

lines.zh: 脚跟钉在石头上，没松过。
lines.en: My heels are fixed to the stone.
I draw a heavy breath.
I have not moved a step.

lines.zh: 你从门那边带来的东西。
lines.en: What you brought through the portal.
I will not eat it.

lines.zh: 这里的东西都留不住味道。
lines.en: Nothing here keeps its taste.

lines.zh: 拿开，这东西在这留不住。
lines.en: Put it away - nothing keeps here.
It rots quickly here.
You hold it out and will not let go.
Then as you say.
That much is not worth a block.
I never eat such things.

lines.zh: 拿在手里也没用，我不吃。
lines.en: Holding it up won't help. I don't eat.
You threw yourself at me.

lines.zh: 你撞得后退，我脚下没动。
lines.en: You're knocked back; my feet haven't moved.
The far side of the island cracked.
You have heard that sound.
A piece of rubble struck you.
I did not throw it.
They move on their own.

lines.zh: 你撞上来，浮岛裂了一道。
lines.en: You crash into me; the island cracks.
I drew back half a step.
That is the first time I have stepped back.
No one keeps anyone company here.
Best you do not start.
Only stone and I are here.
There is no more to it.
This place keeps no echoes.
Let alone anything else.
I will not answer that question.
And do not dwell on it.

lines.zh: 这地方养不出那种东西。
lines.en: Nothing like that grows here.

lines.zh: 我连自己的名字都念不出来。
lines.en: I cannot even say my own name.
That patch of violet on the ground.
It is slowly spreading out.
That is not mine.
It turns at my feet; I don't touch it.
I grind it into the stone with my foot.
Now it is quiet.
It circles my foot.
I let it stop there.

lines.zh: 末地的边缘，一脚踢下去。
lines.en: One kick off the End's edge.
It wobbled at the edge twice.

lines.zh: 门那边的人，终于走到底了。
lines.en: The one from the gate finally reached the end.
I stand on End stone.

lines.zh: 你走的时候这里没有人。
lines.en: No one was here when you left.
Now there is.

lines.zh: 这两者之间的事，我们可以慢慢说。
lines.en: What lies between we can discuss slowly.
Then we start with you.

lines.zh: 紫色的火从地上爬起来。
lines.en: Violet fire climbs up from the ground.
It turns around you.

lines.zh: 你多看一会儿就习惯了。
lines.en: Watch a while and you will grow used to it.
You stepped back a pace.
There is nothing over there.

lines.zh: 那声音，整座岛都听得见。
lines.en: The whole island can hear it.
It grows louder.
Soon it will be the last.
You grip your sword until the knuckles pale.
That was not my deed.
It is this ground at work.

lines.zh: 你手上的东西开始发黑。
lines.en: What you hold is turning black.
I stand in the centre without moving.
You circle around me.

lines.zh: 每绕一圈，浮岛就小一块。
lines.en: Each circuit, the island shrinks.
You have not yet noticed.
The stone under you has thinned.
Two more circuits and it is gone.
So you had better stop.
You grope the wall and find no door.
One step past the edge is nothing.
I have not taken a step.
I have only stood and watched.
I am on your left now.
Now on your right.
I did not run a single step.

lines.zh: 我只是站着换了一下面。
lines.en: I only turned my face.
The rubble on the island shifts with me.

lines.zh: 浮岛在缩，你的路也在缩。
lines.en: The island shrinks, and so does your road.
You never once looked back.
Behind you there's only me and rubble.
This much I understand.
I raise a hand and the violet fire arrives first.

lines.zh: 你的护甲上多了一层亮。
lines.en: A sheen spreads over your armor.
That is no reflection.
I charge straight forward.
The island cracks beneath us.
You catch yourself at the edge.
This time I am not in a hurry.
My hand comes down on your shield.
The shield begins to heat.
Your hand came loose.
It falls on the stone and cracks.
From the End's sky, I come down.
Your legs buckle.
You did not block that one.
The End sky begins to change colour.
Not the usual violet.
Something blacker.
It presses toward the ground.
I rise in the middle of it.

lines.zh: 浮岛上的碎石跟着浮起来。
lines.en: The rubble on the islands lifts with me.
Rubble lifts and circles around me.

lines.zh: 你听见一道很长的声音。
lines.en: You hear one long sound.
That is not the wind.
I have watched you all along.

lines.zh: 从我起来的时候就在看。
lines.en: Since the moment I rose.
You have little time left.
Use it for running.

lines.zh: 我的影子盖住了半座岛。
lines.en: My shadow covers half the island.
The other half is in the dark.

lines.zh: 紫色的火沿着岛的边线烧。
lines.en: Violet fire burns along the island's rim.
Only the two of us remain inside it.

lines.zh: 我起来的时候，那些柱子晃了。
lines.en: When I rose, the pillars shook.
They are steady now.
The last violet light has gone out.

lines.zh: 火在我身上烧，和我的火混在一起。
lines.en: Fire burns on me, mixing with my own.

lines.zh: 我从高处落下来，浮岛塌了半边。
lines.en: I drop from above and half the island collapses.
There is no water up here.
The blast pushes the rubble far out.

lines.zh: 那东西穿过紫光，扎进我肩。
lines.en: It passes through the violet glow and buries in my shoulder.

lines.zh: 那法术压了一下我的火。
lines.en: That spell presses my fire down.
I stopped relying on that long ago.

lines.zh: 雷从黑天里落下来，打在我身上。
lines.en: Lightning falls from the black sky onto me.
There is nothing beneath my feet now.
